title: Remind me every day
summary: At the time you choose, Taskiem reminds you on WhatsApp or Telegram of what you asked it to.
description: Every day at the time you choose (Lagos time), you get your reminder on the WhatsApp or Telegram you linked to Taskiem, or by email. Nothing to connect: a good first workflow.
